name: Director General, Fire Services
description: Issuing authority for Head Office (MSB) Provisional and Occupancy NOCs.

name: Director of Fire Services
description: Reviews Head Office files; issuing authority for Head Office renewals and declarations.

name: Director of Fire Services (Civil Defence)
description: DFS-CD review note on Head Office files.

name: Additional Director of Fire Services
description: ADFS review note on Head Office files.

name: District Fire Officer
description: Chairman of the inspection committee (Head Office files), DFO note (Regional files), issuing authority for District files.

name: Regional Fire Officer
description: RFO note on Head Office files; issuing authority for Regional files.

name: Monitoring (read-only)
description: Sees every application and the reports; takes no workflow action.

name: Station Fire Officer
description: Inspects Regional and District files; member of the inspection committee.

name: Section (Head Office scrutiny)
description: Scrutiny note (documents, plans, fees, bank guarantee) on Head Office files.
